info.description: Empire website and CMS API. The browser calls `/api/*` on the site and Next.js forwards it here. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. Staff calls use the `__Host-empire_session` cookie; writes also send `X-CSRF-Token` (from `/api/v1/auth/me`). `x-permission` names the permission an operation needs (handbook/ARCHITECTURE.md §11).
info.title: Empire API

Sign in. Sets the session cookie; 5 failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.

post.description: Change own password (other sessions are signed out).
Email a reset link (same reply whether or not the email exists).
Set a new password with a reset or account-setup token. Signs out everywhere.
Process pending events (and the daily clean-up). One run at a time; others get 429.
